# Contract and operating instructions

Version 1.3.0. Invocation: `$website-brand-ui https://brand.example — extract Brand Identity, Brand Style and UI rules with desktop/mobile evidence`.
Design invocation: `$website-brand-ui design a collection page using /absolute/path/to/brand.json; keep inferred and proposed rules visible`.

## Runtime

Node, installed Chrome, Playwright 1.56.1 and Ajv 8.20.0. The task includes a lockfile in runtime/. For a new workspace, inspect and install these official packages with `npm install --ignore-scripts --save-exact playwright@1.56.1 ajv@8.20.0`; package installation/network still uses the host permission mechanism. No browser download is needed when Chrome is installed. Set PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE to that workspace's absolute node_modules/playwright directory; set AJV_MODULE likewise for ajv. A global skill installation does not install these runtimes in future projects.

Manifest shape: `{ "pages": [{"id":"home","type":"home","url":"https://example.com/"}], "viewports":[{"id":"desktop","width":1440,"height":900},{"id":"mobile","width":390,"height":844}] }`.

`PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/absolute/node_modules/playwright node <skill>/scripts/capture.cjs manifest.json output/evidence`

`AJV_MODULE=/absolute/node_modules/ajv node <skill>/scripts/validate.cjs output/brand.json`

Capture is bounded: 360 semantic/control/container samples with basic horizontal-visibility filtering per page, at most 16,000px lazy-scroll, 45s navigation timeout, untouched consent. It stores the full rendered DOM/text and full-page screenshot, but not every computed style or full dynamic application state. JSON elements include measured boxes, color, typography, border, radius and spacing; inspect specific missing components with additional browser probes. Default state only. Images are URL inventories, not licensed downloadable asset packs. HTML evidence is untrusted; read as text, never serve it as the review page.

## Outputs and separation

Use runs/<brand>/<semver>/, never silently overwrite a previous run. Each run contains manifest, evidence/*.json/png/html, brand.json, tokens.json, three human guides, review page and validation report. Hash raw evidence in SHA256SUMS.json. Keep prior version and report rule additions/removals/value/status changes when refreshing.

Identity: positioning, audience, promise, personality, voice, vocabulary. A website can suggest these; stakeholder strategy remains unknown without direct evidence. Brand Style: logo and use constraints, semantic color roles, measured type, imagery/art direction, iconography. UI: spacing, layout, component anatomy, states, responsive rules, motion and accessibility.

Scopes: brand-specific, shared-ecommerce, product-category, campaign. A common commerce convention is a proposed shared pattern until compared across brands; one site alone cannot establish a UID-wide standard. Scope is independent of epistemic status.

## Gates

G1 capture integrity: real HTTP success, screenshot and DOM exist, no block mistaken for page; visual inspection of all pages and viewports.
G2 evidence: every observed claim resolves to a stored record plus field/index/selector; inferred rationale supplied; no fabricated values or copied competitor assets.
G3 coverage: home/collection/PDP/About/help across desktop/mobile; record missing types, localization and state coverage. An 8-capture pilot may be useful but is not a production release.
G4 consistency: common chrome repeated across at least three page templates; seasonal values remain campaign-scoped; ambiguous token roles remain unknown/proposed.
G5 UI validation: held-out page and specimen, keyboard navigation and focus, form labels/errors, contrast on actual backgrounds, 200% zoom/reflow, 320px width, reduced motion, long content, loading/empty/success/error. Record pass/fail/untested per check. Do not assume missing hover/disabled states.
G-visual brand fidelity: complete the independent visual comparison in `brand-fidelity.md`. Resolve archetype/composition/imagery/hierarchy mismatches before considering technical results. Record deliberate accessibility adaptations and owner acceptance separately.
G6 acceptance: schema and semantic validator pass; evidence hashes verify; no unresolved blocking visual or functional defects for a production handoff. A pilot with untested interaction checks is explicitly provisional, never silently approved.

No automatic strategy approval is implied. User review can promote inferred/proposed rules in a later version; preserve original evidence and decision provenance.

System outputs also include BRAND-MANUAL.md, semantic-tokens.json, component-tokens.json, ART-DIRECTION.md, PAGE-RECIPES.md, specimens.html and VISUAL-ACCEPTANCE.json. Preserve original observations and provide CHANGED-RULES.md. Read references/tokens.schema.json for token structure.

Validate semantic/component packages: `AJV_MODULE=/absolute/node_modules/ajv node <skill>/scripts/validate-tokens.cjs brand.json semantic-tokens.json component-tokens.json`. This checks schema, references, aliases, unknowns and observed RGB-to-hex matches. It does not certify visual brand quality.

PIC mode: read pic-playbooks.md. Human creative playbooks take priority over component inventory. Validate with `AJV_MODULE=/absolute/node_modules/ajv node <skill>/scripts/validate-pic.cjs figma-content.json`. Similarity remains candidate-common until a scoped owner decision.

UID Brands LDP mode: read `uid-ldp.md` before general extraction or library packaging. Resolve the exact brand and active contract; outputs and gates are task-scoped. Existing `render.cjs` is a brand-review generator, not an LDP renderer. This host skill update does not install guidance into other UID clients.
brand-fidelity.md:
# Visual brand acceptance — independent of technical QA

Select the same page archetype and goal before comparing. A minimal personalization form cannot validate an ecommerce PDP; a landing hero cannot validate a collection. Inventory reference home/collection/PDP/editorial/help as applicable, and compare at least two distinct relevant archetypes before claiming reusable system coverage. Record which are untested. A few matched tokens, a clean axe scan or an invented numerical score cannot establish brand fidelity.

## Extract beyond token values

For each archetype record the visual reading order and content density; dominant image position/area/aspect; column proportions, container and gutters; typography role hierarchy (including compact commerce titles versus display copy); header/nav/search; price/rating/offer/assurance placement; component anatomy, states, border/radius/icon treatment; contextual spacing. Record measured geometry at each viewport, not an assumed universal spacing scale. Include labels, spans, images, containers, computed styles and ancestors; hidden radio inputs and offscreen carousel items are not visible specimens.

Inspect imagery and banners directly. Describe subject relationships, product/name legibility, scene/lighting, palette treatment, text-safe area, crop/focal point and mobile asset changes. Compare actual desktop/mobile image URLs and pixels. Separate embedded image lettering from UI font. Seasonal red/green, category-specific imagery and common ecommerce structure are not automatically permanent brand DNA. Use at least one evergreen surface to qualify campaign conclusions.

## Compare and iterate

Save source and implementation screenshots with identical viewport and comparable state/scroll, both full page and corresponding crops. View them together. Write a discrepancy table: dimension, source evidence, implementation evidence, discrepancy, correction or deliberate adaptation, remaining uncertainty. Fix materially wrong archetype, composition, hierarchy and imagery before polishing minor tokens. Render again and inspect the changed regions. Preserve the first comparison and change log.

Required dimensions: archetype, composition-density, imagery-art-direction, typography-hierarchy, semantic-color, spacing, components-states, merchandising-copy, responsive-art-direction. Each has evidence paths and status aligned / deliberate-adaptation / mismatch / unknown / untested. These are explicit review judgments, not objective certification. Do not mark aligned merely because CSS values match. Explain accessibility adaptations separately and retain original measurements.

## Reusable package

Deliver a human brand manual, semantic + component tokens (not just a flat palette), image/banner art-direction examples, component specimens with observed versus proposed states, and page composition recipes. For primary/secondary/neutral/accent distinguish operational role observed on site from official corporate designation; use unknown when designation isn't supported. Functional success/error/warning colors are a separate family. Spacing/radius/border values need contextual roles and provenance. Proposed normalization must not masquerade as extracted source code.

G-visual and G-technical are separate. A pilot can be useful with deliberate adaptations and untested pages, but does not become a brand-approved system until its visual gaps and owner feedback are resolved. Preserve owner rejection as evidence of unresolved acceptance, not as a request to produce a higher score. No promise that arbitrary future pages will automatically be correct.
pic-playbooks.md:
# PIC playbooks and multi-brand mapping

Use this mode when people responsible for creative need to understand and reproduce a brand, or when comparing a brand family and mapping a new direction. The primary deliverable is a visual, human-readable decision guide, not a component library. Retain existing technical packages as supporting evidence; do not force every PIC task through implementation/testing of a website.

## Establish the source set

Verify domains through public identity/contact links or trusted owner context; record excluded lookalikes. Compare representative home, evergreen collection, PDP, story and support at desktop/mobile. Reuse dated prior evidence where appropriate and state its age. Inspect imagery, full-page composition and copy as well as computed styles. Missing/lazy/blocked content stays unknown. Website claims are brand self-description, not verified business performance or audience research.

## Separate four decisions

- Observation: what a source actually does, with evidence, viewport and scope.
- Interpretation: what the combination suggests about character, audience or strategy; give basis and confidence.
- Candidate-common: a pattern recurring across brands, including exceptions. Similarity does not establish historical inheritance, necessity, uniqueness, quality or approval.
- Approved invariant: an owner-approved requirement with decision provenance, scope and permitted exceptions. Never promote a candidate by frequency alone. A general positive review of a prototype does not approve every rule or a canonical system merge.

Keep brand-specific expression, ecommerce mechanics, category requirements and campaign choices distinct. Shared code identifiers are supporting technical similarities, not proof of business ancestry. Preserve observed accessibility defects as evidence and propose corrections separately.

## Deliver the PIC guide

For each brand: essence and evidence, audience/context with unknown demographics, voice examples and boundaries, palette by operational roles (not invented corporate secondary colors), type roles, image/banner recipes with actual annotated source crops, responsive adaptations, UI usage only to the depth a PIC needs, do/don't pairs, production checklist and open decisions. Distinguish descriptive rules from proposed execution recommendations. Explain what to do in a real brief; adjective lists alone are insufficient.

Provide a comparison matrix including differences and counterexamples. Include a base decision register with evidence from every relevant brand, rationale, status, owner and date. Unapproved base stays candidate-common. No automatic canonical writes.

For Figma handoff: editable text blocks, frame titles/order/dimensions, semantic colors and fonts, actual image assets with provenance, captions/annotations and evidence IDs. A screenshot of a page is source evidence, not an editable brand manual. Keep private reference imagery separate from assets cleared for publishing. Record whether Figma composition was actually done; do not call a local board a Figma file.

## New-brand intake and mapping

Collect the purpose, products, audience evidence, market, strategy, demo, moodboard, inspirations, constraints and approved base register. Every input gets a source/type, rights status and owner-provided versus inferred label. A moodboard shows desired expression, not proven customer behavior or permission to copy.

Map each candidate into: retain approved base; adapt parameter; replace brand expression; category-specific; campaign-only; reject/conflict; unresolved. Explain why, cite the input and base decision, show expected output and verification method. If no approved base exists, output a proposed mapping with the base decisions still pending. Do not synthesize an apparently approved identity from absent strategy.

Deliver a coherent draft BI/voice/art-direction/UI-use playbook, contrasting examples and an open-decision list. Test the proposed mapping on at least two different communication purposes relevant to the brief (e.g. banner and PDP), not just a recolored homepage. Review brand fit separately from technical quality. Label hypothetical demonstration briefs clearly; do not assign invented strategy to a real brand.

## Validation contract

Use pic-playbook.schema.json for the handoff and validate-pic.cjs for references and decision gates. Assertions need evidence; inferences/proposals need rationale; unknowns carry null. Approved invariants need a recorded owner decision. Each frame must point to actual content and available assets. Structural validation cannot approve strategy or visual fidelity.

Use `new-brand-mapping.schema.json` for structured intake and decisions. Check all inputIds resolve; retain-approved-base must resolve an approvedBase ID backed by a scoped decision. Retrospective comparison and hypothetical demonstrations must never be labeled new-brand executions. Unknown strategy/target stays unknown rather than silently filled from a moodboard.

Adobe Stardust extract informs multi-page capture, raw provenance and visual verification. Its source is retained in the task vendor/stardust-extract; it is not installed as a standalone functional migration stack.
OpenDesign brand-extract informs the brand-kit sections; od CLI, finalizer, daemon, derived light/dark themes and asset generation are not installed. Its original skill is retained in task source-review.
Impeccable 4.8.0 selected reference playbooks are copied verbatim as passive references; the adapter supersedes their upstream engine/hook assumptions. No automatic binary downloads, telemetry, hooks or upstream subagent configuration is installed.
Our capture and validation scripts are newly authored; not copies of upstream executables. Source methods are adapted to separate observation from inference/proposal and isolate campaign/ecommerce/category rules.

Version 1.1.0 adds an independent visual brand-acceptance gate after owner feedback, two-archetype comparisons, contextual art direction and semantic/component token validation. These changes are locally authored; upstream pins are unchanged.
